description: This file defines the FavoritesFragment class, which is responsible for displaying a list of favorite recipes in the app. It manages UI components such as a RecyclerView, StateView, and handles data loading from a repository to update the UI accordingly.

classes.name: FavoritesFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a list of user's favorite recipes, loading data asynchronously and updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up the RecyclerView adapter and layout manager, and invokes loading of favorites.

methods.name: loadFavorites
methods.description: Fetches favorite recipes asynchronously and updates the UI based on whether the list is empty or populated.
